payload_note: Derived from results/group_a_release_runtime_j15_20260522.json and updated with the validated runtime overrides from results/group_a_runtime_opt_sweep_20260522.json plus the 2026-05-24 local re-optimization sweeps. Historical backtest result blocks are retained from the baseline payload; optimized performance evidence remains in the sweep JSON and handoff documents.

group_a_llm_sentiment_config.note: Daily market-level LLM sentiment features are merged into Group A shared market state and also drive a sentiment risk gate that can neutralize 00631L or enable 00632R defense.

group_a_sentiment_gate_config.note: LLM sentiment remains defensive by default. Positive leverage boost support exists, but the validated release keeps it disabled after runtime sweep degradation.

group_b_sentiment_gate_config.note: Sentiment gate is disabled because Group B LLM sentiment is disabled.

group_a_pva_sigmoid_config.note: Latest Group A runtime keeps 30% base PVA blend, raises J-state overlay to 0.17, raises minimum leverage scale to 0.40, raises buy-dip strength to 0.80 after 2026-05-24 local re-optimization, and leaves S-state drift boost disabled after sweep validation.

group_a_inverse_hedge_config.note: 00632R is treated as a short hedge and is forcibly exited when M state ends or max holding days is reached.

execution_timing.note: Signals use day-t data, trades execute at next trading day's open, and performance is marked at next close.

group_a_dca_config.note: Group A DCA is applied only during evaluation/backtest, not PPO training reward.

runtime_overlay_refine.note: Canonical runtime payload keeps the same best checkpoint and applies the validated local runtime optimization overlay: pva_j_state_weight 0.17, pva_min_leverage_scale 0.40, and pva_buy_dip_strength 0.80. DCA day remains 20. The 2026-05-24 re-optimization confirmed 0.80 beats 0.70 and did not find a better value at 0.90 or 1.00. S-state drift boost, inverse hold extension, higher target vol, and positive sentiment boost all stayed off after sweep validation.
runtime_overlay_refine.selected_by: highest scored eligible candidate from the 2026-05-24 local runtime re-optimization without worse drawdown or extra trades
